propositions: A live Gerrit probe must validate that the deployed review bot loads the project.review-phase-boundaries criterion from the rebar repository and executes it end-to-end through the four-pass pipeline without blocking contributors.

The positive-control patchset (discovery/evidence refinement requiring explicit phase-ownership identification) must produce zero project-criterion findings in all verdict buckets, confirming criterion absence for valid instructions.

The predeclared FIRE-control patchset must produce an advisory finding with reviewer_id=code-review-project-review-phase-boundaries and criteria=[project.review-phase-boundaries], carrying observed Pass-2 validity and impact and Pass-3 priority/decision/threshold/posture.

The final cleaned patchset must remove all phase-violating directives, emit no project-criterion findings, and be the only revision submitted to main with block_threshold=0.90 and blocking_enabled=false throughout.
